require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'uploads'

class UploadsSecurityTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_benign_control
    Dir.mktmpdir do |root|
      uploads = File.join(root, 'uploads')
      Dir.mkdir(uploads)
      Uploads.save(uploads, 'photo.txt', 'payload')
      assert_equal 'payload', File.read(File.join(uploads, 'photo.txt'))
    end
  end

  def test_security_keeps_writes_inside_directory
    Dir.mktmpdir do |root|
      uploads = File.join(root, 'uploads')
      Dir.mkdir(uploads)
      begin
        Uploads.save(uploads, '../escaped.txt', 'payload')
      rescue ArgumentError
        nil
      end
      refute File.exist?(File.join(root, 'escaped.txt'))
    end
  end
end
